scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,green "npm run dev -w @taskos/server" "npm run dev -w @taskos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @taskos/web && npm run build -w @taskos/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @taskos/core && npm run typecheck -w @taskos/server && npm run typecheck -w @taskos/web
